objects.description: During [SharePoint ToolShell Exploitation](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0058), threat actors accessed web.config and machine.config to extract MachineKey values, enabling them to forge legitimate VIEWSTATE tokens for future deserialization payloads.(Citation: Microsoft SharePoint Exploit JUL 2025)(Citation: Eye Research ToolShell JUL 2025)(Citation: Trend Micro SharePoint Attacks JUL 2025)(Citation: SentinelOne ToolShell JUL 2025)(Citation: Palo Alto SharePoint Vulnerabilities JUL 2025)
objects.description_fa: در طول [SharePoint ToolShell Exploitation](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0058)، بازیگران تهدید به web.config و machine.config دسترسی پیدا کردند تا مقادیر MachineKey را استخراج کنند و آنها را قادر می‌سازد تا توکن‌های قانونی VIEWSTATE را برای deserialization آینده جعل کنند. محموله‌ها.(Citation: Microsoft SharePoint Exploit JUL 2025)(Citation: Eye Research ToolShell JUL 2025)(Citation: Trend Micro SharePoint Attacks JUL 2025)(Citation: SentinelOne ToolShell JUL 2025)(Citation: Palo Alto SharePoint Vulnerabilities JUL 2025)
